9 contributions

The service and food here are really great
Nov 2023 • Family
I have enjoyed Japanese cuisine at many Japanese restaurants but perhaps Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is my favorite Japanese restaurant brand. I often go to eat at the restaurant located on Pasteur Street, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. Besides the food is really delicious, the service here is so good. I have come here many times to eat with my family, friends and colleagues. The sashimi here is very fresh and delicious. I ate almost every item on the menu. The space is spacious and beautiful and there is also a great private room.
